progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ab2 and dwells most on Bb in Nowruz-e Khara. The line peaks at Eb4 (331.4 Hz) at 0:05.9. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Bb3 → A3 → F3 → C3 → C3 → Eb4).
